evidence.quote: Jetson AGX Orin modules deliver up to 275 TOPS of AI performance with power configurable between 15W and 60W.

notes.zh: 回答机器人本体上「板端能跑多大模型」的内存与算力上限。不回答实际帧率：TOPS 是官方标称口径，真实推理速度取决于量化方式、输入分辨率与散热条件，需要实测才有结论。
notes.en: Answers the on-board memory and compute ceiling that decides how large a model a robot body can run. It does not answer real frame rates: TOPS is a vendor rating, and actual inference speed depends on quantisation, input resolution and thermal headroom, which only measurement can settle.
